summary: Clatsop County, OR site: a 1928 crow's nest and tent cabin; listed as abandoned with no date; an undated note says an 8-foot crow's nest was still there.

facts.design: crow's nest (8 ft in an undated note) with a tent cabin
facts.status_note: Listed as abandoned by two sources, neither dated; an undated firelookout.com note says an 8-foot crow's nest was still there

events.note: Rex's page lists a crow's nest and tent cabin under 1928; the entry does not say they were built that year

evidence.supports: 1928 entry lists a crow's nest (8 ft, still there) and tent cabin; site abandoned
evidence.quote: 1928: crows nest (8' still there), tent cabin. Abandoned.

evidence.supports: the site is called the Dog Thief Lookout on Rex's page
the site is called Dog Thief Point on Forest Lookouts
agency is the Oregon Department of Forestry
county Clatsop; status Abandoned on the FFLA list

corrections.why: The FFLA list and Rex's page both say Abandoned, not gone; the 'gone' value appears to come from mapping Abandoned to gone. Rex's page also reports an 8-foot crow's nest still there (undated).

notes_for_editor: Three thin sources and no build date, design detail, staffing or fire history found. The 1928 entry lists a crow's nest and tent cabin, so it is recorded as an 'other' event rather than a build. The brief's 'gone' status matches the FFLA mapping of 'Abandoned'; the sources say abandoned, and the undated note says an 8-foot crow's nest remained, so a visit could find remains. Two WebSearch runs returned only the same pages plus unrelated Clatsop items; the Clatsop State Forest Wikipedia page was read and does not mention the lookout. No access, visit or rental information found; the story says so and points to ODF.
